decisions.twoFields: The dialog holds the two existing ways in, 'Open It for This Visit' and 'Save It to This Account', each with its own paste field. They are different commands (an opened mission clears when the person leaves; a saved one is kept with an acknowledgement and a retry that must resend the same command), so a single shared field would change the token handling of a private capability. The spec's goal, one action and one dialog instead of two forms and a link on the page, is met. A shared field is a follow-up if the owner wants it.
decisions.deferred: Data that loads when a tab opens, and one quiet refresh in the page header, are not in this PR. The Account settings tabs are CX PR 3c.
decisions.tests: No existing test changed: both components keep their old layout where there is no provider, so v3-saved-commercial-ui, customer delivery and decision specs pass unchanged.
